column1: # Task 220 P1 — Independent AOT suite tombstones (tests/aot/run_aot_tests.sh)
# The standalone suite is adopted into CTest as `aot_standalone_suite`, which runs
# every case and treats EXACTLY the cases below as expected failures. Any other
# Columns are TAB-separated; the gate keys on the first whitespace-delimited field.
#   case          suite-relative name without .xr (as printed by the runner)
#   failure_class one of: stale-api | vtable-diff | float-diff | coro-diff | other
#   disposition   one of: fix | rewrite | delete
#   owner_task    task number responsible for carrying out the disposition
# Governance rule: tombstones only DECREASE (只减不增). A case that starts passing
# must be pruned from this list (the gate reports such cases as "resolved").
# Stale-API cases already cleared in this phase (rewritten to the current surface,
# no longer failing, therefore NOT tombstoned): basic/builtin_methods,
